content:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT 1: Autoscaler & serving-runtime instability in apac-sg1. Symptoms: oscillating scale, crashloops on GPU pods, CUDA allocation failures, short brownout windows for hosted API. Paging oncall.

maya (oncall): taking. sam/lee/tori/nina please join. Any immediate customer-facing impact?

sam (sre): We're seeing a pattern: sudden burst of scheduling -> CA scales nodes up to satisfy pending pods -> shortly after, pods OOM and die (exit 137), nodes show `kubelet` evicting pods for memory pressure -> CA aggressively scales down. Result: thrash and repeated restarts. Current error rate ~6.3% on embeddings endpoints in region.

lee (eng-runtime): runtime logs show `cudaMalloc failed: out of memory` from multiple containers. Notable: model variant `model-beta@v2-q4` has a larger transient working set due to KV cache and recent batch-size default raise. We also see the container runtime killing processes with SIGKILL when RSS exceeds cgroup limit.

tori (eng-infra): autoscaler metrics: saw spike from 1->16->3 nodes in ~4 minutes. CA logs show scaleUp for pending pods with reason `insufficient resources`. Scale down then triggered after a few minutes due to low node utilization. Looks like CA + HPA interplay.

maya (oncall): nina, are any customers hitting 5xx pages?

nina (support): a handful of customers show elevated 502/504s. One enterprise tenant reported degraded throughput for embedding batch jobs. I'm drafting an incident blurb.

sam (sre): Immediate mitigations I'd run now:
- Cap cluster-autoscaler max nodes for the GPU nodepool to prevent overshoot.
- Increase `--scale-down-unneeded-time` and `--scale-down-utilization-threshold` so CA doesn't aggressively remove nodes post-spike.
- Pin critical routes to stable low-memory model variant.
- Disable bursty large-batch inference features for routes causing churn (reduce `max_batch_tokens`).
- Taint/cordon nodes showing repeated OOMs to stop re-scheduling.

maya (oncall): lee, can runtime do a fast route pin? evan stand by to coordinate deploy rollback if needed. tori, can you apply CA limits?

lee (eng-runtime): Doing route pin to `model-beta@v1` for `/embed` and `/vectorize` traffic for premium keys. Also disabling dynamic KV prefetch on these routes. Commands: 

```
# pin route to stable
redwood route update /embed --model model-beta@v1 --priority high
# reduce batch tokens to limit memory
redwood config set runtime.batch.max_tokens 2048 --scope route:/embed
# disable KV prefetch
redwood config set runtime.kv.prefetch false --scope route:/embed
```

deploy-bot: starting route update (canary -> promote).

tori (eng-infra): Applying CA changes: setting `--max-nodes=8` for gpu-pool, `--scale-down-unneeded-time=15m`, `--scale-down-utilization-threshold=0.45` and `--scale-up-delay=60s`. Also disabling aggressive balance for similar nodegroups.

ops-bot: detected node `sg-gpu-07` repeated OOMs; applying taint `oom=true:NoSchedule` and cordoning.

sam (sre): Also adding a throttle in HPA controller: require two consecutive target breaches before scaling up replicas for heavy endpoints.

maya (oncall): nina please send an initial customer message: keep it short re-routing + mitigation.

nina (support): Draft: "We're mitigating an autoscaler-related instability causing intermittent errors for embeddings in apac-sg1. We've routed traffic to a stable model variant and adjusted autoscaler settings. We'll post updates in 30 mins." Posting now.

lee (eng-runtime): Route pin rolled out. Observing new pods with ~20-35% lower GPU memory RSS for the pinned replica set. KV prefetch off.

evan (devex): Early telemetry: error rate dropped 6.3% -> 1.5% over 7 minutes; p99 latency improved. No new `cudaMalloc` errors in the last 6 minutes.

sam (sre): Noting a curious artifact: some pods had `NVIDIA-SMI` reporting driver mismatch warnings pre-crash (modules mismatch after kernel patch). Tori, can infra check driver versions across the nodepool?

tori (eng-infra): Will audit driver versions and kernel headers across nodes. Capturing `nvidia-smi -q` + `uname -r` on cordoned nodes and collecting `dmesg`. Also saving container logs and CRI stats.

maya (oncall): good. any other mitigations?

sam (sre): One more: temporarily disable large autoscaler scale-ups by adding a cool-off period to prevent single-request bursts from creating many nodes. We already set `--scale-up-delay`. Also setting CA flag `--scale-down-delay-after-add=10m` to avoid immediate scale down.

lee (eng-runtime): For follow-ups: we'll add runtime guard that detects OOM spikes and auto-degrades features (KV prefetch, large-batch) per-route. Also adding a circuit-breaker to fail fast to a fallback model variant if memory pressure detected.

maya (oncall): okay handoff plan: tori investigate driver/kernel mismatch; lee reproduce memory pattern in staging with synthetic bursts; sam update CA/HPA playbooks; nina keep customers updated. I'll stay till 20m stable and then hand back.

[~18 minutes later]

deploy-bot: route canary -> all succeeded.

evan (devex): Metrics: error rate back to baseline, p99 within 1.1x of normal. No new OOMs in last 12 minutes. Node flaps down to zero.

maya (oncall): stable for 15m. Lowering to P2 and closing active pager. Please file a postmortem with triage pointing to: autoscaler-HPA interaction + runtime KV/batch memory profile + driver mismatches on a subset of nodes.

sam (sre): Filing postmortem, assigning follow-ups to eng-infra and eng-runtime. Key action items: 1) CA defaults for GPU clusters (cooldowns and max-nodes), 2) runtime automatic memory-degradation feature, 3) driver version consistency check and node remediation runbook.

ops-bot: created follow-up task #INC-2026-231: "Autoscale brownout root cause & mitigations" assigned to tori/lee/sam.

nina (support): Sent customer update and will follow up with a detailed note in 2 hours once root cause confirmed.

maya (oncall): thanks team. quick note: consider adding a pre-rollout pressure test for quantized variants that simulates CA behaviour.

lee (eng-runtime): will add canary pressure tests to the deployment pipeline and a rollback hook on `OOM` spikes.

tori (eng-infra): adding node-driver validation to node bootstrap and a script to repair mismatched drivers.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE 1: mitigated. Severity downgraded to P2; follow-ups created.

maya (oncall): nice work. closing thread; follow-ups assigned.

(END OF THREAD)
